description: Login timing attack protection enhancement - GREEN phase implementation
execution_evidence: All 52 tests passed. Key timing evidence: 'should throw UnauthorizedException if user not found' = 299ms (was 103ms before fix), 'should throw UnauthorizedException if password is invalid' = 343ms (was 1ms before fix). Both paths now have constant-time delay in 250-350ms range. New GREEN tests confirm: (1) timing difference between paths < 60ms, (2) both paths take >= 250ms, (3) constantTimeLoginDelay produces variable delays.
changes_made: Added private async constantTimeLoginDelay() method in AuthService
Method generates random delay between 250-350ms (simulating bcrypt rounds=12)
Replaced fixed 100ms setTimeout in 'user not found' path with constantTimeLoginDelay()
Added constantTimeLoginDelay() call to 'wrong password' path (previously had no delay)
Updated tests: replaced RED phase tests with GREEN phase validation tests
